svg.title: Разгибание одной ноги в тренажёре — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Seated single-leg knee extension using a selectorized leg-extension machine. Three-quarter view shows padded seat and backrest, side handles and low cylindrical shin roller on machine lever. Left: working knee bent near ninety degrees, working lower shin behind roller, foot raised off floor. Right: same thigh stays fully against seat, ONLY working knee straightens so its lower shin lifts the roller up to near horizontal. Other knee remains bent, other foot clearly off the moving roller, below and to side in BOTH phases. No kicking, no hip rise. Show the hinge at working knee level and the lower leg pushing a roller. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
